name: Summit AZ - Website Tracker 2026-06-23
body:
> Tracker · Summit Az · 2026-06-23

# Summary
The first full inventory of every published page and blog post on summitplumbingpros.com, pulled live on Jun 23, 2026, before the Sep 3 relaunch. It shows the site architecture that the later work is built on.

# Contents
- Overview tab: 164 pages and posts in total.
- Core and service pages: 35 (home, contact, main service hubs, PPC landing pages, legal).
- City page tabs, 10 cities each: Emergency Plumbing, General Plumbing, Drain Cleaning, Water Heaters, Tankless Water Heaters, Water Softeners, Water Leak Detection, Sewer Line Repair, Pipe Lining, Water Pressure, Garbage Disposal, Fixture Installation (12 services x 10 cities = 120).
- Blogs by Kim: 9 published posts at that date.
- Each row lists page type, service or topic, title, URL, slug and notes.

# Decisions and status
- Superseded by the live page tracker in `page-tracker\` (202 URLs by Sep 30) and the Sep 2026 Rank Math trackers. Keep as the June reference point.
